title: Mongolian
html_source:
Mongolism is a discredited term for Down syndrome.
Down syndrome refers to the 19th century English physician J. Langdon Down who described the condition in 1866. In great error, Langdon Down attributed the condition to a “reversion” to the “mongoloid race.”
MedicineNet.com

May be an allusion to Giga Bariceva, (English Studies from Archives to Prospects: Volume 1 – Literature …, Volume 1, p84).
